body:
The .org registry's delegation for carepyre.org lists jocelyn.ns.cloudflare.com (correct) and nicholas.ns.cloudflare.com (typo -- should be nicolas.ns.cloudflare.com, confirmed nicholas.ns.cloudflare.com doesn't resolve at all). This is why the Cloudflare zone has sat in status=pending/ns_typo since it was created 2026-08-10 -- a month before today, not something this session caused (only read-only Cloudflare API calls were made). DNS still resolves day-to-day because jocelyn alone is enough to serve authoritative answers. Fix is a one-character change at Namecheap's nameserver settings (nicholas -> nicolas); blocks full Cloudflare zone activation, relevant to the Stalwart mail DNS work in ops/stalwart/terraform.

⚓ ☃
title: Found real root cause of carepyre.org's stuck Cloudflare zone: nameserver typo at Namecheap
